commands.title: Copy This Project's Snippets Into Library
Copy This Project's Skills Into Library
Recompose Project From Its Saved Selection
Choose Snippets and Skills for This Project

view/title.when: view == mdcompose.snippets || view == mdcompose.skills || view == mdcompose.project

view/item/context.when: view == mdcompose.snippets && viewItem == snippet && mdcompose.state == 'ready' && isWorkspaceTrusted
view == mdcompose.skills && viewItem == skill && mdcompose.state == 'ready' && isWorkspaceTrusted

mdcompose.executablePath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `mdcompose` executable. Leave empty to use the one on the executable search path. This can be set only in user or machine settings, never by a workspace.

mdcompose.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long a single `mdcompose` command may run before it is stopped.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, mdcompose shows your libraries and the project's state but does not run anything that changes files.
